note: KBC's fee information document for the Compte Base KBC (1 January 2026): credit cards come with the account free, with or without Flex Budget, the revolving credit drawn on the KBC credit card, whose variable debit rate is 8.97% a year. Read again in full on 2026-10-30: a cash withdrawal with the KBC credit card at a machine costs 1.00% (at least 5.00 euros; 2.00% at a bank or exchange office, not written), and one in another currency adds a 1.60% exchange margin, written as the card's foreign fee (the document gives the margin for withdrawals; it gives none for card payments in another currency). The main banks: BNP Paribas Fortis, KBC, Belfius and ING Belgium; only KBC's document was read on 2026-10-30, and it prices one KBC credit card.
